what: Pressing a card flips it on the Y axis 0→90→0 over .6s (ease-in-out), and at the midpoint .3s the front (night) swaps to the back (day). Once on the back, .5s later a speech bubble above the card rises from 35% below at .85x, overshoots to −54%·1.04x and settles (.5s ease-out). Pressing again or pressing another card in the same group sends the bubble up at .9x (.5s ease-in) and the card returns to its front. Only one card is on its back at a time.

options.dur: Flip duration (ms), default 600 — the face swaps at the midpoint. Match the css --fx-dur too
options.pop: Time until it becomes the back side and the bubble appears (ms), default 500
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card to press (several in a group)
options.[data-fx-part=front]·[data-fx-part=back]: Front and back inside the card (if absent, only the data-flipped attribute changes — the user may swap the drawing on the fx:flip event)
options.[data-fx-part=balloon]: Sibling speech bubble right behind the card (optional)
options.fx:flip: Event emitted from the card when the face changes (detail.flipped)
